en.t: Emperor Decius orders everyone in the Roman Empire (except Jews) to make sacrifices to the Roman gods
en.s: The Roman Empire was a state that dominated the Mediterranean and much of Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa during the classical period. The Roman Republic had previously conquered most of these territories, which later came under permanent single-person rule following Octavian's rise to power and the establishment of the Augustan Principate in 27 BC. By the late 3rd century AD, the empire had been divided many times.

zh.t: 德西乌斯皇帝命令罗马帝国所有人（犹太人除外）向罗马诸神献祭
zh.s: 罗马帝国是古典时代统治地中海沿岸及欧洲、西亚和北非广大地区的国家。此前，罗马共和国已经征服了其中大部分领土。屋大维崛起并于公元前27年建立奥古斯都元首制后，这些领土进入长期的单人统治时期。到公元3世纪晚期，帝国已经历多次分裂。

en.t: Pope Leo X issued the papal bull Decet Romanum Pontificem, excommunicating Martin Luther for refusing to retract 41 alleged errors found in his 95 Theses and other writings
en.s: Pope Leo X (Italian: Leone X; born Giovanni di Lorenzo de' Medici, 11 December 1475 – 1 December 1521) was head of the Catholic Church and leader of the Papal States from 9 March 1513 to his death in December 1521. Born into the prominent political and banking Medici family of Florence, Giovanni was the second son of Lorenzo de' Medici, the de-facto ruler of the Florentine Republic, and was elevated to the cardinalate in 1489.

zh.t: 教宗良十世颁布《罗马教宗应当》诏书，将拒绝撤回《九十五条论纲》等著作中41项被指错误主张的马丁·路德逐出教会
zh.s: 教宗良十世（意大利语：Leone X；原名乔瓦尼·迪·洛伦佐·德·美第奇，1475年12月11日—1521年12月1日）自1513年3月9日起担任天主教会领袖和教宗国统治者，直至1521年12月去世。他出生于佛罗伦萨显赫的政治与银行世家美第奇家族，是佛罗伦萨共和国实际统治者洛伦佐·德·美第奇的次子，1489年获任枢机。

en.s: The Siamese–Cambodian War (1591–1594)(Khmer: សង្គ្រាមសៀម-កម្ពុជា (១៥៩១-១៥៩៤),Thai: สงครามสยาม-กัมพูชา พ.ศ. 2134), also known as The Siamese Invasion of Longvek, was a military conflict fought between the Ayutthaya Kingdom and the Kingdom of Cambodia. The war began in 1591 when Ayutthaya invaded Cambodia in response to continuous Khmer raids into their territory. The Kingdom of Cambodia was also facing religious disagreements within the country. This gave the Siamese a perfect opportunity to invade. The first invasion was interrupted before it achieved its goals. The Ayutthayan king Naresuan returned two years later, eventually subjugating the whole country and finally sacking the Cambodian capital of Longvek on 3 January 1594.

zh.s: 1591至1594年，阿瑜陀耶王国与柬埔寨王国交战，也称暹罗入侵洛韦克。柬埔寨军队不断袭扰暹罗领土，阿瑜陀耶因此于1591年入侵柬埔寨。当时柬埔寨国内还存在宗教纷争，给暹罗提供了入侵机会。第一次进攻尚未实现目标便中断。两年后，阿瑜陀耶国王纳黎萱再次出兵，最终征服柬埔寨全境，并于1594年1月3日攻陷、洗劫其首都洛韦克。

en.t: The first issue of Berlingske, Denmark's oldest continually operating newspaper, is published
en.s: Berlingske, previously known as Berlingske Tidende (Danish: [ˈpɛɐ̯le̝ŋskə ˈtsʰiːðn̩ə], 'Berling's Times'), is a Danish national daily newspaper based in Copenhagen. It is considered a newspaper of record for Denmark. First published on 3 January 1749, Berlingske is Denmark's oldest continually operating newspaper and among the oldest newspapers in the world.

zh.t: 丹麦现存连续出版时间最长的《贝林时报》创刊
zh.s: 《贝林时报》（Berlingske，原名Berlingske Tidende，意为“贝林的时报”）是一份总部设在哥本哈根的丹麦全国性日报，被视为丹麦的记录报。该报于1749年1月3日首次出版，是丹麦连续出版时间最长的报纸，也是世界上历史最悠久的报纸之一。

en.s: The Battle of Princeton (January 3, 1777) was a pivotal battle in which General George Washington's revolutionary forces defeated British forces near Princeton, New Jersey. On the night of January 2, 1777 George Washington, Commander-in-Chief of the Continental Army, repulsed a British attack at the Battle of the Assunpink Creek in Trenton. That night, he evacuated his position, circled around General Lord Cornwallis' army, and went to attack the British garrison at Princeton. Brigadier General Hugh Mercer of the Continental Army clashed with two regiments under the command of Lieutenant Colonel Charles Mawhood of the British Army.

zh.s: 1777年1月3日，乔治·华盛顿将军率领革命军，在新泽西州普林斯顿附近击败英军，赢得一场关键战役。前一晚，大陆军总司令华盛顿刚在特伦顿的阿孙平克溪战役中击退英军进攻。当夜，他撤离阵地，绕过康沃利斯勋爵的军队，转而进攻普林斯顿的英军驻军。大陆军休·默瑟准将的部队，与英军查尔斯·莫胡德中校指挥的两个团发生交战。

en.s: The Battle of Videau's Bridge (also known as Smith's plantation) was an engagement of the American Revolutionary War fought on January 3, 1782 in Charles Town District, currently Berkeley County, South Carolina. The British routed an American force opposing a foraging expedition they sent from Charleston. The British claimed to kill 57 and capture 20 Americans.

zh.s: 1782年1月3日，美国独立战争中的维多桥战役在南卡罗来纳州查尔斯镇地区，也就是今天的伯克利县爆发。此战也称史密斯种植园战役。英军从查尔斯顿派出一支搜集粮草的队伍，击溃了前来阻挡的美军。英军声称打死57名美军、俘虏20人。

en.s: The Capture of Shimoga, a town and fortress held by forces of the Kingdom of Mysore, occurred on 3 January 1792, after a preliminary battle with the attacking forces of the British East India Company and the Marathas, not far from the town on 29 December, had scattered much of its defending army. The defenders surrendered after the fort's walls were breached.

zh.s: 1792年1月3日，英国东印度公司与马拉塔联军攻占了迈索尔王国军队控制的希莫加城及其堡垒。此前，联军于12月29日在城镇附近进行的一场战斗中，击溃了大部分守军。城堡围墙被突破后，守军投降。

en.s: The Battle of Noirmoutier was a confrontation in the War in the Vendée which took place on 3 January 1794 between the Republicans and the Vendeans for control of the island of Noirmoutier. Situated in the Bay of Bourgneuf and linked to the mainland by the Gois causeway, the island was occupied on 12 October 1793 by General Charette's Vendean troops.

zh.s: 1794年1月3日，旺代战争中的共和派军队与旺代军队交战，争夺努瓦尔穆捷岛。该岛位于布尔讷夫湾，通过戈瓦堤道与大陆相连。1793年10月12日，沙雷特将军的旺代军队曾占领这里。

en.s: The Battle of Cacabelos was a minor battle of the Peninsular War that took place on 3 January 1809, at the bridge just outside the village of Cacabelos, Province of León, Spain, as Sir John Moore's British army was making its retreat to A Coruña. The French cavalry Brigadier General Auguste François-Marie de Colbert-Chabanais was killed by a sharpshooter at Cacabelos.

zh.s: 1809年1月3日，半岛战争中的一场小规模战斗在西班牙莱昂省卡卡韦洛斯村外的桥边展开。当时，约翰·穆尔爵士的英军正撤往拉科鲁尼亚。法国骑兵准将奥古斯特·弗朗索瓦-马里·德·科尔贝-沙巴奈在这里被神枪手击毙。

en.s: A gubernatorial special election was held in Virginia on January 3, 1812. The speaker of the Virginia House of Delegates James Barbour was elected without opposition. The previous governor of Virginia George W. Smith died on December 26, 1811. Peyton Randolph succeeded to office in his capacity as president of the Council of State and acted as governor until the election of a successor.

zh.t: 1812年美国弗吉尼亚州州长特别选举
zh.s: 1812年1月3日，弗吉尼亚州举行州长特别选举。州众议院议长詹姆斯·巴伯因无人竞争而当选。前任州长乔治·W.史密斯于1811年12月26日去世后，佩顿·伦道夫凭借州参事会主席身份继任代理州长，直到新州长选出。

en.s: The Battle of Arapey was an encounter between the Luso-Brazilian forces under José de Abreu Mena Barreto and the Artiguist forces led by José Artigas, the independentist caudillo himself, in Salto, modern-day Uruguay. On 3 January 1817 Abreu attacked Artigas army in its camp, surprising the defenders. The Luso-Brazilian forces secured a victory and seized all of the supplies of the independentist army.

zh.s: 1817年1月3日，若泽·德阿布雷乌·梅纳·巴雷托率领的葡萄牙—巴西军队，在今乌拉圭萨尔托袭击了何塞·阿蒂加斯亲自率领的独立派军队营地，守军措手不及。葡巴军队最终获胜，并夺走独立派军队的全部补给。

en.s: The 1831 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on January 3, 1831, in order to elect the governor of Maryland. Former National Republican governor Daniel Martin was elected by the Maryland General Assembly against incumbent Democratic governor Thomas King Carroll in a rematch of the previous election.

zh.s: 1831年1月3日，马里兰州举行州长选举。国家共和党籍前州长丹尼尔·马丁与民主党籍现任州长托马斯·金·卡罗尔再次对决，州议会最终选出马丁担任州长。

en.s: The Peruvian Civil War of 1834 was a revolt by supporters of former president Agustín Gamarra against the government. Gamarra had wanted Pedro Pablo Bermúdez as his successor to the presidency instead of Luis José de Orbegoso. On April 17, 1834, the two sides clashed in the Battle of Huaylacucho, in Huancavelica resulting in a victory for the revolutionaries. On April 24, 1834, there was another clash near Jauja.

zh.s: 1834年秘鲁内战是前总统阿古斯丁·加马拉的支持者反对政府的起义。加马拉希望由佩德罗·巴勃罗·贝穆德斯继任总统，而不是路易斯·何塞·德·奥尔韦戈索。1834年4月17日，双方在万卡韦利卡的瓦伊拉库乔战役中交锋，起义军获胜。4月24日，双方又在豪哈附近发生冲突。

en.t: Joseph Jenkins Roberts is sworn in as the first president of Liberia
en.s: Joseph Jenkins Roberts (March 15, 1809 – February 24, 1876) was an African American merchant who emigrated to Liberia in 1829, where he became a politician. Elected as the first (1848–1856) and seventh (1872–1876) president of Liberia after independence, he was the first man of African descent to govern the country, serving previously as governor from 1841 to 1848.

zh.t: 约瑟夫·詹金斯·罗伯茨宣誓就任利比里亚首任总统
zh.s: 约瑟夫·詹金斯·罗伯茨（1809年3月15日—1876年2月24日）是一名非裔美国商人，1829年移居利比里亚，后来从政。利比里亚独立后，他当选为首任总统（1848—1856年），又担任第七任总统（1872—1876年）。他是首位治理该国的非洲裔人士，此前于1841年至1848年担任总督。

en.t: American Civil War: Delaware votes not to secede from the United States
en.s: The American Civil War (April 12, 1861 – May 26, 1865; also known by other names) was a civil war in the United States between the Union ("the North") and the Confederacy ("the South"), which was formed in 1861 by Southern states that had seceded from the Union to preserve slavery in the United States.

zh.t: 美国内战：特拉华州投票决定不脱离美国
zh.s: 美国内战发生于1861年4月12日至1865年5月26日，交战双方为联邦（“北方”）与邦联（“南方”）。邦联于1861年由脱离联邦的南方各州组成，这些州脱离联邦是为了保留美国的奴隶制。

en.s: The Battle of Cockpit Point, the Battle of Freestone Point, or the Battle of Shipping Point, took place on January 3, 1862, in Prince William County, Virginia, as part of the blockade of the Potomac River during the American Civil War. After victory at First Battle of Bull Run, the Confederate States Army (CSA) established a defensive line from Centreville along the Occoquan River to the Potomac River. The Confederates used the Potomac’s banks as gun positions to halt Union traffic on the river, protecting Manassas Junction to the west and Fredericksburg to the south and to close the Potomac River to shipping and isolate Washington.

zh.s: 1862年1月3日，美国内战中的科克皮特角战役在弗吉尼亚州威廉王子县展开，是封锁波托马克河行动的一部分。这场战斗也称弗里斯通角战役或希平角战役。第一次布尔溪战役获胜后，邦联军沿奥科昆河建立了一条从森特维尔延伸至波托马克河的防线。他们利用波托马克河岸设置炮位，阻断联邦军的河上运输，保护西面的马纳萨斯枢纽和南面的弗雷德里克斯堡，并通过封锁航运来孤立华盛顿。

en.t: Construction work begins on the Brooklyn Bridge in New York, United States
en.s: The Brooklyn Bridge is a cable-stayed suspension bridge in New York City, spanning the East River between the boroughs of Manhattan and Brooklyn. Opened on May 24, 1883, the Brooklyn Bridge was the first fixed crossing of the East River. It was also the longest suspension bridge in the world when opened, with a main span of 1,595.5 feet (486.3 m) and a deck 127 ft (38.7 m) above mean high water.

zh.t: 美国纽约布鲁克林大桥开工
zh.s: 布鲁克林大桥是纽约市一座结合斜拉与悬索结构的桥梁，横跨东河，连接曼哈顿与布鲁克林两个行政区。大桥于1883年5月24日开放，是东河上的首条固定跨河通道。它通车时也是世界上最长的悬索桥，主跨长1,595.5英尺（486.3米），桥面高于平均高潮位127英尺（38.7米）。

en.s: The Battle of Bapaume was a battle during the Franco-Prussian War which defeated French attempts to relieve the besieged city of Prone. The battle was fought on 3 January 1871 near the town of Bapaume. The Prussian 1st Army had reached Bapaume at the end of December while at the same time the French Army of the North under Faidherbe moved out to break the German siege of Prone. Both sides encountered each other near Bapaume. Although Faidherbe's green troops held their own against the outnumbered but experienced Prussians, they didn't follow up their advantage and retreated.

zh.s: 1871年1月3日，普法战争中的巴波姆战役在巴波姆镇附近爆发，使法军为被围困的佩罗讷城解围的尝试失败。普鲁士第一集团军于12月底抵达巴波姆，与此同时，费代尔布指挥的法国北方军出动，试图打破德军对佩罗讷的围困。双方在巴波姆附近相遇。费代尔布手下缺乏经验的新兵，虽能抗衡人数较少但经验丰富的普军，却没有乘势追击，而是撤退。

en.t: In the Battle of Bapaume, an engagement in the Franco-Prussian War, General Louis Faidherbe's forces bring about a Prussian retreat
en.s: The Franco-Prussian War, occasionally known as the Franco-German War, and sometimes referred to in France as the War of 1870, was a conflict between France and the North German Confederation led by Prussia. Lasting from 19 July 1870 to 28 January 1871, the conflict was caused primarily by France's determination to reassert its dominant position in continental Europe, which appeared in question following the decisive Prussian victory over Austria in 1866.

zh.t: 普法战争巴波姆战役中，路易·费代尔布将军的部队迫使普军撤退
zh.s: 普法战争又称法德战争，在法国有时称为“1870年战争”，是法国与普鲁士领导的北德意志邦联之间的战争，持续于1870年7月19日至1871年1月28日。普鲁士于1866年决定性地击败奥地利后，法国在欧洲大陆的主导地位受到挑战；法国决意重申这一地位，是战争爆发的主要原因。

en.s: The Battle of Núi Bop (3–4 January 1885) was a French victory during the Sino-French War. The battle was fought to clear Chinese forces away from the French forward base at Chu, and was an essential preliminary to the Lạng Sơn Campaign in February 1885.

zh.s: 1885年1月3日至4日，中法战争中的努伊博战役以法军获胜告终。法军发动此战，是为了清除其驻朱镇前沿基地周围的清军，也为同年2月的谅山战役作必要准备。

en.s: The 1888 Calgary municipal election was held on January 3, 1888 to elect a Mayor and six Councillors to sit on the fourth Calgary Town Council from January 16, 1888 to January 21, 1889. The 1888 election was the first after the Town Council had expanded from four councillors to six councillors.

zh.s: 1888年1月3日，卡尔加里举行市政选举，选出一名市长及六名议员，组成第四届镇议会，任期从1888年1月16日至1889年1月21日。这是镇议会议员人数由四人增至六人后举行的首次选举。

en.t: A gun battle in the East End of London leaves two dead. It sparked a political row over the involvement of then-Home Secretary Winston Churchill
en.s: The East End of London, often referred to within the London area simply as the East End, is the historic core of wider East London, east of the Roman and medieval walls of the City of London and north of the River Thames. It does not have universally accepted boundaries on its northern and eastern sides, though the River Lea is usually seen as the easternmost boundary.

zh.t: 伦敦东区枪战造成两人死亡，时任内政大臣丘吉尔的介入引发政治争议
zh.s: 伦敦东区通常在伦敦当地简称“东区”，是广义东伦敦的历史核心，位于伦敦城罗马及中世纪城墙以东、泰晤士河以北。东区的北部和东部边界并无公认划分，不过利河通常被视为其最东端边界。

en.t: The 1911 Kebin earthquake devastates Almaty in Russian Turkestan
en.s: The 1911 Kebin earthquake, or Chon-Kemin earthquake, struck Russian Turkestan on 3 January. Registering at a moment magnitude of 8.0, it killed 452 people, destroyed more than 770 buildings (which was almost all of the city) in Almaty, Kazakhstan, and resulted in 125 miles (201 km) of surface faulting in the valleys of Chon-Kemin, Chilik and Chon-Aksu.
en.n: The calendar date follows the earthquake’s January 3 UTC origin time. The introduction uses a moment-magnitude estimate of 8.0; historical magnitude estimates differ.

zh.t: 1911年克宾地震重创俄属突厥斯坦的阿拉木图
zh.s: 1911年克宾地震又称琼凯明地震，于1月3日袭击俄属突厥斯坦。地震矩震级为8.0级，造成452人死亡，摧毁了哈萨克斯坦阿拉木图逾770座建筑，几乎波及全城，并在琼凯明、奇利克和琼阿克苏河谷形成长达125英里（201公里）的地表断裂。
zh.n: 此处日期采用地震起震时刻对应的协调世界时（UTC）1月3日。简介采用矩震级8.0的估计值；历史资料中的震级估计并不完全一致。

en.s: The 1912 Prince Edward Island general election was held in the Canadian province of Prince Edward Island on January 3, 1912. The election was won by the governing Conservatives, led by incumbent Premier John A. Mathieson, nearly sweeping the island's 30 districts and granting the Conservatives their first clear general election victory since the 1886 election.

zh.s: 1912年1月3日，加拿大爱德华王子岛省举行选举。现任省长约翰·A. 马西森领导的执政保守党赢得选举，几乎横扫全省30个选区。这是保守党自1886年选举以来，首次在全省选举中取得明确胜利。

en.t: First Balkan War: Greece completes its capture of the eastern Aegean island of Chios, as the last Ottoman forces on the island surrender
en.s: The First Balkan War lasted from October 1912 to May 1913 and involved actions of the Balkan League (the Kingdoms of Bulgaria, Serbia, Greece and Montenegro) against the Ottoman Empire. The Balkan states' combined armies overcame the initially numerically inferior (significantly superior by the end of the conflict) and strategically disadvantaged Ottoman armies, achieving rapid success.

zh.t: 第一次巴尔干战争：希俄斯岛最后一批奥斯曼军队投降，希腊完成占领这座爱琴海东部岛屿
zh.s: 第一次巴尔干战争从1912年10月持续至1913年5月，由巴尔干同盟的保加利亚、塞尔维亚、希腊和黑山四个王国对抗奥斯曼帝国。巴尔干各国的联军迅速击败了战略处境不利的奥斯曼军队。奥斯曼军队最初在兵力上处于劣势，但到战争结束时人数已明显超过对手。

en.s: A moment magnitude 6.3–6.4 earthquake affected southeastern Mexico, in the states of Puebla and Veracruz, on 3 January 1920 at 22:25 local time. A maximum Mercalli-Cancani intensity of XI–XII (Extreme) was recorded in the epicenter, between Chilchotla and Patlanalá. While estimates of the death toll vary across different sources, ranging from 648 to 4,000 fatalities, it is the second deadliest earthquake in Mexico, behind another earthquake in 1985 that killed more than 9,000 people.

zh.s: 1920年1月3日当地时间22时25分，一场矩震级6.3至6.4级的地震袭击墨西哥东南部的普埃布拉州和韦拉克鲁斯州。位于奇尔乔特拉与帕特拉纳拉之间的震中记录到的最大麦加利—坎卡尼烈度为XI至XII度，即极烈。不同资料对死亡人数的估计从648人到4,000人不等。这是墨西哥死亡人数第二多的地震，仅次于造成逾9,000人死亡的1985年地震。

en.t: Minnie D. Craig becomes the first woman elected as Speaker of the North Dakota House of Representatives, the first woman to hold a Speaker position anywhere in the United States
en.s: Minnie Craig (née Davenport, November 4, 1883 – July 2, 1966) was an American legislator, notable as the first female speaker of a state House of Representatives in the United States. Born in Phillips, Maine on November 4, 1883 to Marshall and Aura (Prescott) Davenport, Minnie Davenport was a bright student. After graduating from the Farmington State Normal School she attended the New England Conservatory of Music and became a school teacher.

zh.t: 明妮·D. 克雷格当选北达科他州众议院议长，成为美国首位女性议长
zh.s: 明妮·克雷格（娘家姓达文波特，1883年11月4日—1966年7月2日）是美国立法机构议员，以成为美国首位女性州众议院议长而闻名。她于1883年11月4日出生于缅因州菲利普斯，父母为马歇尔·达文波特和奥拉·普雷斯科特·达文波特。明妮自幼成绩优异，从法明顿州立师范学校毕业后进入新英格兰音乐学院学习，后来成为教师。

en.s: The 1936 Tschammerpokal final decided the winner of the 1936 Tschammerpokal, the 2nd season of Germany's knockout football cup competition. It was played on 3 January 1937 at the Olympiastadion in Berlin. VfB Leipzig won the match 2–1 against Schalke 04 to claim their 1st cup title.

zh.s: 1937年1月3日，德国足球淘汰杯赛的第二届赛事——1936年度恰默杯——在柏林奥林匹克体育场举行决赛。莱比锡VfB以2比1击败沙尔克04，首次夺得杯赛冠军。

en.t: Proceedings of the U.S. Congress are televised for the first time
en.s: The United States Congress is the legislative branch of the federal government of the United States. It is a bicameral legislature, including a lower body, the U.S. House of Representatives, and an upper body, the U.S. Senate. They both meet in the United States Capitol in Washington, D.C. Members of Congress are chosen through direct election, though vacancies in the Senate may be filled by a governor's appointment.

zh.t: 美国国会会议首次通过电视转播
zh.s: 美国国会是美国联邦政府的立法机构，实行两院制，由作为下院的众议院和作为上院的参议院组成。两院均在华盛顿哥伦比亚特区的美国国会大厦开会。国会议员通过直接选举产生，不过参议院出现空缺时，可以由州长任命人员补缺。

en.t: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas, the central bank of the Philippines, is established
en.s: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (lit. 'Central Bank of the Philippines'; commonly abbreviated as BSP in both Filipino and English) is the government-owned central bank of the Philippines. It was established on January 3, 1949, and then re-established on July 3, 1993, pursuant to the provision of Republic Act 7653 or the New Central Bank Act of 1993 as amended by Republic Act 11211 or the New Central Bank Act of 2019.

zh.s: 菲律宾中央银行的菲律宾语名称为Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas，菲律宾语及英语通常均缩写为BSP，是政府所有的中央银行。该行最初成立于1949年1月3日，后来依据第7653号共和国法（《1993年新中央银行法》）于1993年7月3日重组成立。这部法律此后经第11211号共和国法（《2019年新中央银行法》）修订。

en.s: The Tianjin campaign was the epitome of the Pingjin campaign, fought between the nationalists and the communists during the Chinese Civil War in the post-World War II era. The result of the Tianjin campaign helped to determine the outcome of the Pingjin campaign. The original communist plan was to capture Tanggu first to cut off the nationalist escape route via sea and then force the nationalists in Beijing and Tianjin to surrender, in order to save the two historical cities from the destruction of the war.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 天津战役是第二次世界大战后中国内战期间，国民党军队与共产党军队交战的平津战役中的关键一战，其结果影响了整个平津战役的结局。共产党军队最初计划先攻占塘沽，切断国民党军队的海上退路，再迫使北平和天津的守军投降，以使这两座历史名城免遭战火破坏。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Egypt on 3 January 1950, with a second round on 10 January. The result was a victory for the Wafd Party. They were the last parliamentary elections that took place under the monarchy, and the last genuinely contested legislative election in Egypt until the election following the Revolution of 2011.

zh.s: 埃及于1950年1月3日举行议会选举，第二轮投票于1月10日举行，最终由华夫脱党获胜。这是埃及君主制时期的最后一次议会选举，也是2011年革命后那次选举之前，埃及最后一次具有实质竞争的立法机构选举。

en.t: Frances P. Bolton and her son, Oliver from Ohio, become the first mother and son to serve simultaneously in the U.S. Congress
en.s: Frances Payne Bolton (née Bingham; March 29, 1885 – March 9, 1977) was an American politician from the Republican Party. She served in the United States House of Representatives, and was the first woman elected to Congress from Ohio. In the late 1930s, Bolton took an isolationist position on foreign policy, opposing the Selective Service Act in 1940 which introduced the draft, and opposing Lend-Lease in 1941.

zh.t: 俄亥俄州的弗朗西丝·P. 博尔顿和儿子奥利弗成为首对同时任职美国国会的母子
zh.s: 弗朗西丝·佩恩·博尔顿（娘家姓宾厄姆，1885年3月29日—1977年3月9日）是美国共和党政治人物，曾任美国众议员，也是俄亥俄州首位当选国会议员的女性。20世纪30年代末，她在外交政策上持孤立主义立场，反对1940年引入征兵制度的《选择性兵役法》，也反对1941年的《租借法案》。

en.t: A fire damages the top part of the Eiffel Tower
en.s: The Eiffel Tower ( EYE-fəl; French: Tour Eiffel [tuʁ ɛfɛl] ) is a lattice tower on the Champ de Mars in Paris, France. It is named after the engineer Gustave Eiffel, whose company designed and built the tower from 1887 to 1889. Locally nicknamed "La dame de fer" (French for "Iron Lady") for its use of wrought iron, it was constructed as the centrepiece of the 1889 World's Fair, and to crown the centennial anniversary of the French Revolution.

zh.t: 火灾损坏埃菲尔铁塔顶部
zh.s: 埃菲尔铁塔（法语：Tour Eiffel）是一座位于法国巴黎战神广场的格构塔，得名于工程师居斯塔夫·埃菲尔，其公司于1887年至1889年间设计并建造了这座塔。铁塔以熟铁建造，在当地昵称为“铁娘子”（La dame de fer）。它原是1889年世界博览会的标志性建筑，也用于纪念法国大革命一百周年。

en.t: The Hamilton Watch Company introduces the first electric watch
en.s: The Hamilton Watch Company is a Swiss watch manufacturer based in Bienne, Switzerland. Founded in 1892 as an American firm, the Hamilton Watch Company ended American manufacture in 1969, shifting manufacturing operations to the Buren factory in Switzerland. Through a series of mergers and acquisitions, the Hamilton Watch Company eventually became integrated into the Swatch Group, the world's largest watch manufacturing and marketing conglomerate.

zh.t: 汉米尔顿钟表公司推出首款电动腕表
zh.s: 汉米尔顿钟表公司是一家总部位于瑞士比尔的制表商，1892年以美国企业身份创立。1969年，公司结束在美国的生产，将制造业务转移至瑞士的比伦工厂。经过一系列兼并收购，汉米尔顿最终并入斯沃琪集团；后者是世界上最大的钟表制造与营销集团。

en.t: The West Indies Federation is formed
en.s: The West Indies Federation, also known as the West Indies, the Federation of the West Indies or the West Indian Federation, was a short-lived political union that existed from 3 January 1958 to 31 May 1962. Various islands in the Caribbean that were part of the British Empire, including Trinidad and Tobago, Barbados, Jamaica, and those on the Leeward and Windward Islands, came together to form the Federation, with its capital in Port of Spain, Trinidad and Tobago.

zh.s: 西印度群岛联邦是一个短暂存在的政治联盟，存续于1958年1月3日至1962年5月31日。加勒比海多处隶属大英帝国的岛屿联合组成该联邦，包括特立尼达和多巴哥、巴巴多斯、牙买加，以及背风群岛和向风群岛中的一些岛屿。联邦首都设在特立尼达和多巴哥的西班牙港。

en.s: Aero Flight 311, often referred to as the Kvevlax air disaster, was a scheduled domestic passenger flight operated by Aero O/Y (now Finnair) between Kronoby and Vaasa in Finland. The aircraft, a Douglas DC-3, crashed in the municipality Kvevlax (Finnish: Koivulahti), nowadays part of Korsholm (Finnish: Mustasaari) on 3 January 1961, killing all twenty-five people on board. The disaster remains the deadliest aviation accident in Finnish history.

zh.s: Aero航空311号班机是芬兰克罗努比至瓦萨的定期国内客运航班，由Aero O/Y航空公司，即今天的芬兰航空运营。1961年1月3日，执飞的道格拉斯DC-3客机在克韦夫拉克斯市镇坠毁，机上25人全部遇难。克韦夫拉克斯的芬兰语名称为科伊武拉赫蒂，如今属于科什霍尔姆市镇，其芬兰语名称为穆斯塔萨里。这场事故常称“克韦夫拉克斯空难”，仍是芬兰历史上死亡人数最多的航空事故。

en.t: Cold War: After a series of economic retaliations against one another, the United States severs diplomatic relations with Cuba
en.s: The Cold War was a period of international geopolitical rivalry between the United States (US) and the Soviet Union (USSR) and their respective allies, the capitalist Western Bloc and communist Eastern Bloc. It began in the aftermath of the Second World War and ended with the dissolution of the Soviet Union in 1991.

zh.t: 冷战：经历一系列相互经济报复后，美国与古巴断交
zh.s: 冷战是美国与苏联及其各自盟友之间长期的国际地缘政治对抗，对立双方为资本主义西方阵营与共产主义东方阵营。冷战始于第二次世界大战之后，并于1991年苏联解体时结束。

en.t: The SL-1 nuclear reactor, near Idaho Falls, Idaho, is destroyed by a steam explosion in the only reactor incident in the United States to cause immediate fatalities
en.s: Stationary Low-Power Reactor Number One, also known as SL-1, initially the Argonne Low Power Reactor (ALPR), was a United States Army experimental nuclear reactor at the National Reactor Testing Station (NRTS) in Idaho about forty miles (65 km) west of Idaho Falls, now the Idaho National Laboratory. It operated from 1958 to 1961, when an accidental explosion killed three plant operators, leading to changes in reactor design.

zh.t: 爱达荷福尔斯附近的SL-1核反应堆毁于蒸汽爆炸，成为美国唯一直接造成人员死亡的反应堆事故
zh.s: 固定式低功率一号反应堆（SL-1），最初称为阿贡低功率反应堆（ALPR），是美国陆军在爱达荷州国家反应堆试验站（NRTS）建造的试验性核反应堆。该站位于爱达荷福尔斯以西约40英里（65公里），现为爱达荷国家实验室。反应堆从1958年运行至1961年，一次意外爆炸造成三名操作人员死亡，并促使反应堆设计作出调整。

en.s: The 1966 Upper Voltan coup d'état was an event which took place on 3 January 1966 in the Republic of Upper Volta (today Burkina Faso), when following large-scale popular unrest, the military intervened against the government. This forced President Maurice Yaméogo to resign, and was replaced by Lieutenant Colonel Sangoulé Lamizana. Lamizana would go on to rule until 1980, when yet another military coup d'état overthrew him.

zh.s: 1966年1月3日，上沃尔特共和国（今布基纳法索）在爆发大规模民众骚乱后，军方介入反对政府，迫使总统莫里斯·亚梅奥戈辞职，由桑古莱·拉米扎纳中校接任。拉米扎纳此后一直执政至1980年，最终被另一场军事政变推翻。

en.t: International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights
en.s: The International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights (ICESCR) is a multilateral treaty adopted by the United Nations General Assembly (GA) on 16 December 1966 through GA. Resolution 2200A (XXI), and came into force on 3 January 1976. It commits its parties to work toward the granting of economic, social, and cultural rights (ESCR) to all individuals including those living in Non-Self-Governing and Trust Territories.
en.n: This entry records the entry into force, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 《经济、社会及文化权利国际公约》
zh.s: 《经济、社会及文化权利国际公约》（ICESCR）是一项多边条约，由联合国大会于1966年12月16日通过第2200A（XXI）号决议采纳，1976年1月3日生效。公约要求缔约国努力保障所有人的经济、社会和文化权利，包括非自治领土及托管领土上的居民。

en.s: Apple Inc. is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Cupertino, California, in Silicon Valley, and known for consumer electronics, software and online services. Founded in 1976 as Apple Computer Company by Steve Jobs, Steve Wozniak and Ronald Wayne, the company was incorporated by Jobs and Wozniak as Apple Computer, Inc. the following year. Its current name was adopted in 2007 as the company expanded its focus from computers to consumer electronics.

zh.t: 苹果电脑公司正式注册为公司法人
zh.s: 苹果公司是一家美国跨国科技企业，总部位于加利福尼亚州硅谷的库比蒂诺，以消费电子产品、软件和在线服务闻名。史蒂夫·乔布斯、史蒂夫·沃兹尼亚克和罗纳德·韦恩于1976年创立Apple Computer Company；次年，乔布斯与沃兹尼亚克以Apple Computer, Inc.之名注册成立公司法人。2007年，随着业务重心从电脑扩展至消费电子产品，公司采用了现在的名称。

en.s: The second elections to the Arunachal Pradesh Legislative Assembly were held on January 3, 1980. The election was held simultaneously to the 1980 Lok Sabha election. Thirty seats were up for election. A total of 95 candidates contested; 28 from the Indian National Congress (Indira), 28 from the People's Party of Arunachal, 11 from the Indian National Congress (Urs) and 28 independents. The PPA candidate in the Niausa Kanubari constituency, Wanglhu Wangshu, was elected unopposed. INC(I) won 13 seats (with 72,734 votes, 42.58%). The PPA also won 13 seats, with 70,006 votes (40.98%). The remaining four seats went to independents.

zh.s: 1980年1月3日，印度所称“阿鲁纳恰尔邦”举行第二届立法议会选举，与当年的印度人民院选举同步进行，改选30个席位。共有95名候选人参选，包括印度国大党英迪拉派28人、阿鲁纳恰尔人民党28人、国大党乌尔斯派11人，以及28名独立候选人。人民党候选人Wanglhu Wangshu在Niausa Kanubari选区因无人竞争直接当选。国大党英迪拉派获得72,734票，占42.58%，赢得13席；人民党获得70,006票，占40.98%，同样赢得13席；其余4席归独立候选人。

en.s: Varig Flight 797 was a scheduled passenger flight from Abidjan, Ivory Coast to Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. On 3 January 1987, the Boeing 707 crashed during an emergency return to Abidjan, killing all 12 crew members and 38 of the 39 passengers. After an engine failure, the pilot decided to turn back but misjudged the approach and stalled the aircraft.

zh.t: 巴西里约格朗德航空797号班机空难
zh.s: 里约格朗德航空797号班机是从科特迪瓦阿比让飞往巴西里约热内卢的定期客运航班。1987年1月3日，执飞的波音707在紧急返回阿比让时坠毁，12名机组人员及39名乘客中的38人死亡。此前一台发动机发生故障，机长决定返航，但误判了进近过程，导致飞机失速。

en.t: Manuel Noriega surrenders to United States forces during the invasion of Panama
en.s: The United States invasion of Panama began on 20 December 1989 during the presidency of George H. W. Bush. Its purpose was to depose Panama’s de facto ruler, General Manuel Noriega, who was wanted by United States authorities for racketeering and drug trafficking. Noriega surrendered to United States authorities on 3 January 1990. Operation Just Cause continued until 31 January 1990.
en.n: This entry records Noriega’s January 3 surrender, not the January 31 conclusion of Operation Just Cause.

zh.t: 美军入侵巴拿马期间，曼努埃尔·诺列加向美军投降
zh.s: 美国于1989年12月20日入侵巴拿马，当时乔治·赫伯特·沃克·布什担任美国总统。行动旨在推翻巴拿马实际统治者曼努埃尔·诺列加将军；诺列加因敲诈勒索和贩毒受到美国当局通缉。1990年1月3日，诺列加向美国当局投降。“正义事业行动”则持续至1990年1月31日。
zh.n: 此条记录的是诺列加于1月3日投降，而不是1月31日“正义事业行动”结束。

en.s: On Friday, January 3, 1992, a Beechcraft 1900C operating CommutAir Flight 4821 crashed into a wooded hillside near Gabriels, New York while conducting an ILS approach to Runway 23 at the Adirondack Regional Airport. The cause of the accident was determined to be pilot error. There were two people killed in the crash, and two survivors.

zh.t: 康穆特航空4821号班机空难
zh.s: 1992年1月3日星期五，执飞康穆特航空4821号班机的一架比奇1900C飞机，在使用仪表着陆系统进近阿迪朗达克地区机场23号跑道时，撞上纽约州加布里埃尔斯附近一处林木覆盖的山坡。事故被认定由飞行员失误引起，机上两人遇难、两人生还。

en.s: The 1991 Yugoslav campaign in Croatia was an armed conflict between the Yugoslav People's Army (JNA), the Yugoslav Navy and the Yugoslav Air Force, and the Croatian National Guard (ZNG) then the Croatian Army (HV) during the Croatian War of Independence. The JNA was originally deployed in order to preserve Yugoslavia, and the initial plan of the campaign entailed the military occupation of Croatia and the removal of the Croatian leadership elected in 1990.

en.s: START II (Strategic Arms Reduction Treaty) was a bilateral treaty between the United States and Russia on the Reduction and Limitation of Strategic Offensive Arms. It was signed by US president George H. W. Bush and Russian president Boris Yeltsin on 3 January 1993, banning the use of multiple independently targetable re-entry vehicles (MIRVs) on intercontinental ballistic missiles (ICBMs). Hence, it is often cited as the De-MIRV-ing Agreement.

zh.t: 《第二阶段削减战略武器条约》
zh.s: 《第二阶段削减战略武器条约》（START II）是美国与俄罗斯就削减和限制进攻性战略武器签署的双边条约。美国总统乔治·赫伯特·沃克·布什与俄罗斯总统鲍里斯·叶利钦于1993年1月3日签署条约，条文规定禁止在洲际弹道导弹（ICBM）上使用分导式多弹头（MIRV），因此也常被称为“去多弹头化协定”。

en.s: Baikal Airlines Flight 130 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight from Irkutsk to Moscow operated by a Baikal Airlines Tupolev Tu-154 that crashed onto a dairy farm on 3 January 1994 in Mamony whilst the pilots were trying to return to the airport following a mid-air emergency. en.s: The Mars Polar Lander, also known as the Mars Surveyor '98 Lander, was a 290-kilogram uncrewed spacecraft lander launched by NASA on January 3, 1999, to study the soil and climate of Planum Australe, a region near the south pole on Mars. It formed part of the Mars Surveyor '98 mission. On December 3, 1999, however, after the descent phase was expected to be complete, the lander failed to reestablish communication with Earth.

en.t: Israeli–Palestinian conflict: Israeli forces seize the Palestinian freighter Karine A in the Red Sea, finding 50 tons of weapons
en.s: Israel and the Palestinians are engaged in an ongoing military and political conflict about land and self-determination within the former territory of Mandatory Palestine. His arrest and execution were widely condemned by various governments and human rights organizations. He was popular among youth and critical of the Saudi Arabian government, advocating for free elections in Saudi Arabia.
en.n: Saudi Arabia announced the break on January 3, 2016. The attacks in Iran followed the execution of Nimr al-Nimr; this was not an Iranian announcement severing ties.

zh.t: 驻伊朗外交机构遇袭后，沙特阿拉伯宣布与伊朗断交
zh.s: 阿亚图拉谢赫尼姆尔·巴基尔·尼姆尔（1959年6月21日—2016年1月2日），通常称为尼姆尔教长，是来自沙特阿拉伯东部省阿瓦米耶的什叶派教长。他的被捕和遭处决受到多个国家政府及人权组织的广泛谴责。他在年轻人中颇受欢迎，批评沙特政府，并倡导在沙特举行自由选举。
zh.n: 沙特阿拉伯于2016年1月3日宣布断交。伊朗境内的袭击发生在尼姆尔遭处决之后；宣布断交的并非伊朗。

en.t: Chang'e 4 makes the first soft landing on the far side of the Moon, deploying the Yutu-2 lunar rover
en.s: Chang'e 4 (; Chinese: 嫦娥四号; pinyin: Cháng'é Sìhào; lit. 'Chang'e No. 4') is a robotic spacecraft mission in the Chinese Lunar Exploration Program of the CNSA. It made a soft landing on the far side of the Moon, the first spacecraft to do so, on 3 January 2019. A communication relay satellite, Queqiao, was first launched to a halo orbit near the Earth–Moon L2 point in May 2018.

zh.t: 嫦娥四号实现人类首次月球背面软着陆，并部署玉兔二号月球车
zh.s: 嫦娥四号是中国国家航天局探月工程中的无人航天器任务。2019年1月3日，它在月球背面实现软着陆，成为首个完成这一壮举的航天器。此前，通信中继卫星“鹊桥”已于2018年5月发射，前往地月L2点附近的晕轨道。

en.s: On 3 January 2020, Qasem Soleimani, an Iranian major general, was assassinated by an American drone strike ordered by U.S. president Donald Trump near Baghdad International Airport in Iraq, while travelling to meet Iraqi prime minister Adil Abdul-Mahdi. Soleimani was commander of the Quds Force, one of five branches of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), which is designated as a terrorist organization by both the United States and European Parliament.

zh.t: 卡西姆·苏莱曼尼遭暗杀
zh.s: 2020年1月3日，伊朗少将卡西姆·苏莱曼尼在伊拉克巴格达国际机场附近，遭美国无人机袭击身亡。袭击由美国总统唐纳德·特朗普下令，当时苏莱曼尼正前往会见伊拉克总理阿迪勒·阿卜杜勒-迈赫迪。苏莱曼尼指挥圣城旅，它是伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队的五个组成部分之一。原文记载，美国与欧洲议会均将伊斯兰革命卫队列为恐怖组织。

en.s: On January 3, 2021, rebels from the CPC coalition and FPRC attacked Bangassou, the capital of Mbomou, Central African Republic, sparking clashes with MINUSCA peacekeepers. The CPC captured Bangassou within hours on January 3, forcing thousands of civilians to flee to the Democratic Republic of the Congo or to the MINUSCA base in Bangassou. The CPC abandoned the city on January 17 following an ultimatum by MINUSCA.

zh.s: 2021年1月3日，争取变革爱国者联盟及中非复兴人民阵线的叛军，进攻中非共和国姆博穆省首府班加苏，与联合国中非稳定团维和部队发生交战。联盟叛军在数小时内攻占班加苏，迫使数千名平民逃往刚果民主共和国，或躲入当地维和部队基地。联合国中非稳定团发出最后通牒后，叛军于1月17日撤离该城。

en.s: On 3 January 2024, a commemorative ceremony marking the assassination of Qasem Soleimani at his grave in eastern Kerman, Iran, was attacked by two bomb explosions. The attacks killed at least 95 people, and injured 284 others. The Iranian government declared the bombings a terrorist attack, the deadliest such incident in the country since the Cinema Rex attack of 1978.

zh.s: 2024年1月3日，伊朗克尔曼东部苏莱曼尼墓地举行遇刺周年纪念活动时，接连发生两次炸弹爆炸。袭击造成至少95人死亡、284人受伤。伊朗政府将其定性为恐怖袭击，这是该国自1978年雷克斯电影院袭击以来死亡人数最多的同类事件。

en.s: The 2023 Trophée des Champions was the 28th edition of the French super cup. The match was contested by the 2022–23 Ligue 1 champions, Paris Saint-Germain, and the 2022–23 Coupe de France winners, Toulouse. Paris Saint-Germain won the match 2–0 for their record twelfth Trophée des Champions title.

zh.s: 2023年法国超级杯是第28届法国超级杯，由2022—23赛季法甲冠军巴黎圣日耳曼对阵同赛季法国杯冠军图卢兹。巴黎圣日耳曼以2比0获胜，第12次夺得法国超级杯，刷新了该赛事的夺冠次数纪录。

en.t: 2025 Speaker of the United States House of Representatives election
en.s: An election for speaker of the United States House of Representatives took place on January 3, 2025, on the opening day of the 119th United States Congress, two months after the 2024 elections for the United States House of Representatives. The incumbent speaker, Republican Mike Johnson of Louisiana, was re-elected on the first ballot, defeating Hakeem Jeffries with a slim 218–215 majority.

zh.s: 2025年1月3日，即美国第119届国会开幕首日、2024年众议院选举结束两个月后，众议院举行议长选举。来自路易斯安那州的共和党籍现任议长迈克·约翰逊在首轮投票中以218票对215票的微弱多数击败哈基姆·杰弗里斯，获得连任。

en.t: The United States conducts airstrikes across northern Venezuela, including the capital Caracas and captures Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro and first lady Cilia Flores
en.s: The United States of America (USA), also known as the United States (U.S.) or America, is a country primarily located in North America. It is a federal republic consisting of 50 states and a federal capital district, Washington, D.C. The 48 contiguous states border Canada to the north and Mexico to the south, with the semi-exclave of Alaska in the northwest and the archipelago of Hawaii in the Pacific Ocean.

zh.t: 美国空袭包括首都加拉加斯在内的委内瑞拉北部地区，抓获总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗及第一夫人西莉亚·弗洛雷斯
zh.s: 美利坚合众国（USA），通常称为美国，是一个主要位于北美洲的国家。美国实行联邦共和制，由50个州和联邦首都华盛顿哥伦比亚特区组成。本土相连的48个州北接加拿大、南邻墨西哥；另有位于西北部、与本土分离的阿拉斯加州，以及位于太平洋上的夏威夷群岛。
